{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the premises
print("Status values:", df['status'].unique())
print("Revenue values (top 10):", df['revenue'].unique()[:10])
print("Number of rows with revenue == '999999.99'", (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())
print("Number of rows with status == 'completed'", (df['status'] == 'completed').sum())
print("Number of rows with status == 'refunded'", (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum())

# Verify premises
assert (df['status'].unique() == ['completed', 'refunded']).all(), "Premise failed: status has unexpected values"
assert (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum() == 6, "Premise failed: expected 6 internal test orders with revenue 999999.99"
assert df['revenue'].dtype == 'object', "Premise failed: revenue should be string"
assert df['status'].nunique() == 2, "Premise failed: status should have exactly two values"

print("All premises verified.")"}
